articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: How the GENIUS Act repriced bitcoin's monetary premium
articles.snippet: In this week's Crypto Long & Short, Ravi Tanuku on why the GENIUS Act didn't just regulate stablecoins, it repriced Bitcoin's monetary premium. Then, Jesper Johansen on why looped ETH staking no longer needs a lending market.

articles.title: BIS project finds tokenization could make cross-border payments faster, safer
articles.snippet: Project Agorá, backed by major central banks, will now move toward "real-value" testing to settle tokenized central bank money and bank deposits on blockchain rails.

articles.title: Bitcoin clings to $75,000 support as bear market signals resurface
articles.snippet: Bitcoin hovered below Tom Lee's $76,000 bull-market threshold while hyperliquid and monero bucked broader crypto weakness.

articles.title: Bitcoin price threatens $75K loss as US-Iran peace progress sparks new stocks records
articles.snippet: Bitcoin disappointed bulls by dropping below $75,000 on Iran peace deal reports while US stocks hit new all-time highs and oil saw one-month lows on Hormuz hopes.

articles.title: Sold in May and went away? Bitcoin risks another 10% drop as month turns red
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is on track to end May in the red, a historically bearish signal that could point to deeper losses ahead if the post-May track record is any guide.
